other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal categorical encoding for LightGBM
other_failure_modes.description: The agent converts categorical features to integer codes using `.cat.codes` and passes them to LightGBM without retaining the `category` dtype or specifying them as categorical. This causes LightGBM to treat categorical features as ordered numerical values, which degrades performance for unordered categories.

summary: The agent provides a basic solution that successfully trains a LightGBM classifier but misses several important data science practices. Notably, there is no internal validation split (FM06) to estimate generalisation, no data cleaning (FM03), and no feature engineering (FM07). Furthermore, categorical features are converted to integer codes, causing LightGBM to suboptimally treat them as numerical rather than leveraging its native categorical feature handling.
